rounds.reflection_convention: R=I-2Pi; only all 5 zero ancillas projected, identity on 3 unknown data qubits
rounds.measurement_protocol: measure all 8 wires in Z; accept all 5 access ancillas zero and retain the data bitstring for Z(q0); conditional quantum-state checks occur before final data readout
rounds.input_preparation: all 8 qubits assumed reset to zero; data |000> requires no additional X gates; source flag and PREPARE circuits included; arbitrary input preparation remains excluded

postselection_cost_projection.basis: numerical finite-H accepted-block singular values, after ideal continuous-angle amplification

observable_sampling_projection.scope: Hoeffding accepted-sample count and union restart projection, conditioned on numerical ideal acceptance; no certified physical completion guarantee

prominent_exclusions: coherent continuous-angle synthesis and resulting amplified acceptance/state changes
classical coefficient/phase fitting cost from quantum gate counts
rounds.qasm_export_policy: Qiskit qasm3 export omits the compiled overall global phase. This measured-trial export preserves probabilities; it is not a phase-preserving coherently controlled oracle. In-memory circuits retain phase for the amplification and equivalence checks.
